experiment.name: v13-final-h
experiment.description: METARGON v0.13 final paired runs, family H (structurally novel), stable/novel, 4 seeds x 40 episodes. Regression preservation.
experiment.agent_version: metargon_v13 (v0.13 defaults; temporal off on H)

parameters.note: preservation matrix: v13 == v12 on every cell; produced with code byte-identical to commit 437cf9d (git diff 4e61903..437cf9d empty)

metrics.success_rate: fraction of episodes completed (40 per seed)
metrics.exact_discovery_D1: fraction of episodes where a verified temporal hypothesis exactly matches the true ordered rule (first, second) for D1; predicted hypotheses not counted
metrics.exact_discovery_D2: fraction of episodes where a verified hypothesis (compositional or temporal) exactly matches the true rule for D2
metrics.covered_discovery_D1: fraction of episodes where a verified hypothesis's antecedent is a subset of the true D1 rule
metrics.covered_discovery_D2: fraction of episodes where a verified hypothesis's antecedent is a subset of the true D2 rule
metrics.cpu_s: wall-clock CPU seconds for the seed-run
